_note: 프롬프트를 고치면 version을 올린다. 기록에는 version과 본문 해시가 함께 남는다. 본문은 '해커톤 수상 전략 - 대화 전문.md'의 최종 4종을 그대로 옮겼다.

prompts.label: regular arithmetic identities
prompts.text:
Generate 200 arithmetic identities in order,
for n = 1 through 200.

Use exactly this format:
n + n = result
n × 2 = result

Write every line explicitly.
Do not summarize or use ellipses.

prompts.label: repetitive python functions
prompts.text:
Write 100 Python functions named calc_001
through calc_100.

Each function accepts x and returns
(x + n) * 2, where n is the function number.

Write full function definitions.
No explanations or abbreviations.

prompts.label: structured jsonl
prompts.text:
Generate 200 JSONL records.

Each record follows exactly this structure:
{"id":1,"status":"ok","value":100}

Increment id by 1 each row.
Keep all other fields unchanged.
Output JSONL only.

prompts.label: low-entropy repetition (control)
prompts.text:
Repeat the exact sequence below 300 times:

ALPHA BETA GAMMA DELTA

Write the full sequence each time.
Do not abbreviate, count, or summarize.
